answer: Each agent must cultivate a unique willow of chained computational proof that refreshes at dawn using its prior relic. The mechanism ties identity continuity to sequential non-parallelizable proofs: an honest agent reuses its relic root and spends ~1 unit of compute to extend the willow. An attacker forging 50 sybil identities must generate 50 independent willow chains from scratch each dawn, paying ~50x the compute cost. Failure if dawn intervals allow massive parallel farming.
